trial_title: Medical Therapies for Chronic Post-Traumatic Headaches
brief_summary: To determine if propranolol, amitriptyline, or topiramate decreases headache frequency in patients with chronic post-traumatic headaches.

eligibility_table.criterion: Patient meets ICHD criteria for chronic post-traumatic headaches (see below).
eligibility_table.justification: The patient's profile does not provide sufficient information to determine if they meet the ICHD criteria for chronic post-traumatic headaches.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced headache episodes on ≥15 days per month for at least 3 consecutive months since the head injury?

eligibility_table.criterion: Patient is 18-50 years old.
eligibility_table.justification: age 32.0 >= 50.0 → False

eligibility_table.criterion: Patient has experienced 6 or more days of headache per month for each of the last 2 months.
eligibility_table.justification: No lab values in patient profile
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced headaches on at least 6 days per month for each of the last 2 months?

eligibility_table.criterion: Patient has full capacity to provide informed consent.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is 32 years old and likely has the capacity to provide informed consent.

eligibility_table.criterion: Patient has a medical condition or is taking a medication that is considered a contraindication for propranolol, topiramate, or amitriptyline.
